title.zh: 保步映射传递有限历史

statement.en: A map preserving each step of one process into another sends every finite course to a course with the same moves; the converse, endpoints included, holds exactly where every step from an image lifts from each configuration with that image.
statement.zh: 把一个过程的每一步保持到另一个过程的映射，把每个有限程送到动作相同之程；带端点的逆恰在像上出发的每一步都能从具此像的每个构形提升时成立。

laws.en: Where a map f takes every step of P to a step of Q by the same move, every finite trace of P from s to t is a trace of Q from f s to f t with the same moves.
laws.zh: 映射 f 把 P 的每一步取为 Q 中同一动作之步时，P 从 s 到 t 的每个有限迹都是 Q 从 f s 到 f t、动作相同之迹。

laws.en: Where, for every s, every step of Q from q s lifts to a step of P from s by the same move into the fiber of its target, every trace of Q from q s to r is the image of a trace of P from s whose end lies in the fiber of r.
laws.zh: 对每个 s，Q 从 q s 出发的每一步都以同一动作提升为 P 从 s 出发、到其终点纤维中的一步时，Q 从 q s 到 r 的每个迹都是 P 从 s 出发、终点在 r 的纤维中之迹的像。

laws.en: Through a map q, the traces of Q from q s are exactly the images of the traces of P from s, endpoints included, for every s, exactly where q preserves every step and every step of Q from q s lifts to a step of P from s by the same move into the fiber of its target.
laws.zh: 经映射 q，对每个 s，Q 从 q s 出发之迹恰是 P 从 s 出发之迹的像（含端点），恰当 q 保持每一步，并且 Q 从 q s 出发的每一步都以同一动作提升为 P 从 s 出发、到其终点纤维中的一步。

hypotheses.en: Two supplied processes on configurations of any kind, with one type of moves; transport takes step preservation (hstep) as its hypothesis, lifting takes the lifting condition (hlift), and the exactness law states both as the condition of its equivalence.
hypotheses.zh: 两个给定的过程，构形可为任意类型，动作类型相同；传递以保步（hstep）为假设，提升以提升条件（hlift）为假设，精确性规律把两者写成其等价的条件。

hypotheses.en: Traces are finite: a list of moves with every intermediate configuration carried.
hypotheses.zh: 迹是有限的：一列动作，每个中间构形都被携带。

next_delta.en: State transport and exact reading through a map for runs without end, and the correspondence of a state map to an actual system, each with its conditions stated as hypotheses.
next_delta.zh: 对无终的运行陈述经映射的传递与精确读出，并给出状态映射与实际系统的对应，各自的条件写为假设。

correspondence.zh: 状态映射及其实际意义需独立说明；这里只传递已给定历史。
correspondence.en: The state map and its actual meaning require correspondence; this only transports a supplied trace.

does_not_show.en: Step preservation alone does not give the converse: lifting needs a condition at every configuration of each starting fiber.
does_not_show.zh: 保步不独自给出逆：提升需要每个起始纤维中每个构形处的条件。
